faction.name: ScourgeVassal
faction.description: These 天灾 are vassal to the 天灾 Infused Human Empire. Should not appear in lobby, but should be auto-added to the game if the 天灾 Infused Empire are present.

custom_field.name: Allegiance
custom_field.description: Each scourge faction (one for each AI) is friendly to the AI but hostile to each of the other newly added scourge factions. These factions are all also hostile to you.

faction.name: ScourgeCivilWar
faction.description:
The 天灾 remain loyal to the AI, but different Hives of 天灾 no longer trust one another. The chaos of their civil war will prevent them from focusing on you.
<color=#f25e1c>HIGH IMPACT:</color> Each AI will get its own faction of the 天灾. Each scourge faction is an ally to the AI, and enemy to all the other scourge factions and to you.

custom_field.name: Intensity
custom_field.description:
How much of an impact each scourge faction has.
Increasing strength increases how quickly the scourge build units or 建筑, how quickly their units individually mark up, how many top-tier units they can build and how fast they produce their units. At Strength 6 the scourge have access to all their intelligence.

custom_field.name: Allegiance
custom_field.description: Each scourge faction (one for each AI) is friendly to the AI but hostile to each of the other newly added scourge factions. These factions are all also hostile to you.

custom_field.name: AllowDarkZenith
custom_field.description: Instead of only scourge factions spawning (one for each AI), some of those factions may be replaced with Dark 天顶 斯维卡里.

custom_field.name: OnlyDarkZenith
custom_field.description: Instead of only scourge factions spawning (one for each AI), all of those factions will be replaced with Dark 天顶 斯维卡里.

faction.name: TemplarWithoutNecromancer
faction.description:
This variant of the 圣殿骑士 serves the AI regardless of whether there is a 死灵法师. These 圣殿骑士 build powerful defensive 建筑 across the 银河, to make your life harder. They also launch periodic assaults against you.
I have no idea how remotely balanced they will be against Non-死灵法师 player types, but people have expressed an interest in finding out. The only change from the default behaviour is that Rifts won't spawn, since only the 死灵法师 can interact with them.
If you have this faction enabled and also turn on the 死灵法师, you'll get two 圣殿骑士 factions, but I'm not sure how well behaved that will be. This is not supported behaviour.

custom_field.name: Intensity
custom_field.description: How much of an impact are they likely to have on gameplay?

custom_field.name: Allegiance
custom_field.description: The 圣殿骑士 are always Allied To AI.

faction.name: Reapers
faction.description: 被掠夺 planets grant access to this universe to a powerful, evil 死灵法师. They will send dangerous attacks through. This is not visible in the game lobby, and is only exposed in game.

custom_field.name: Allegiance
custom_field.description: This faction is always hostile to all.

custom_field.name: Intensity
custom_field.description: How much of an impact are they likely to have on gameplay? If the 强度 is too low then the 死灵法师 will have fewer 资源 to work with.

faction.name: ReapersWithoutDyson
faction.description:
The 收割者 are a powerful force of Necromancers seeking to conquer the 银河. They will seize planets, or 掠夺 them to fuel their war machine.
The 收割者 exist normally to counter the 戴森 Sidekick, but this version does not require a 戴森 Sidekick.
Badger doesn't have much balance data for this, so if you have problems please give feedback on discord.
Adding this faction alongside a dyson sidekick is not supported (instead just use the dyson sidekick and the 收割者 will be added automatically)

custom_field.name: Allegiance
custom_field.description: This faction is always hostile to all.

custom_field.name: Intensity
